versions.content: The ARTI template shall support SWC specific ARTI additions Description: The ARTI template shall define a mechanism to allow SWC specific ARTI parameters. Rationale: ARTI needs SWC specific evaluations. The Template shall define an “instance” to define values of an SWC. The SWC instance shall include a reference to the SWC definition in the EcuC description. Dependencies: – Use Case: Debuggers and Tracing tools need specific SWC related information to display and trace the SWC activity. Supporting Material: -
